name: dev-tools
title: Dev Tools
description: A bundle of small developer utilities — encode/decode, encrypt, format & minify, convert between data formats, inspect JWTs, browse Unicode, and convert numbers, colors, and timestamps — each a focused, offline command.
author: calii23

commands.name: aes-en--decryptor
commands.title: AES En-/Decryptor
commands.description: Encrypt and decrypt text and files with AES (CTR or GCM)

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Cipher Mode
preferences.description: The cipher mode selected when the command opens. GCM is authenticated; CTR is byte-compatible with the legacy tool.

preferences.name: defaultEncoding
preferences.title: Default Encoding
preferences.description: How ciphertext is encoded when the command opens.

preferences.name: defaultKeyLength
preferences.title: Default Key Length
preferences.description: The AES key length selected when the command opens.

preferences.name: defaultAlgorithm
preferences.title: Default Key Derivation
preferences.description: The hash used to derive the key from the password when the command opens.

commands.name: color-converter
commands.title: Color Converter
commands.description: Convert and adjust colors between hex, rgb(), and hsl(), with an optional alpha channel

commands.name: number-base-converter
commands.title: Number Base Converter
commands.description: Convert a number between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal, with a Unicode preview

preferences.name: defaultBase
preferences.title: Default Source Base
preferences.description: How the input number is interpreted when the command opens.

commands.name: text-analyzer
commands.title: Text Analyzer
commands.description: Analyze clipboard or typed text — counts, byte size, encoding, readability, and character distribution

preferences.name: readingSpeed
preferences.title: Reading Speed
preferences.description: Words per minute used to estimate reading time.

preferences.name: speakingSpeed
preferences.title: Speaking Speed
preferences.description: Words per minute used to estimate speaking time.

commands.name: cron-expression
commands.title: Cron Expression
commands.description: Explain a cron expression in plain English and preview its next run times

preferences.name: defaultCount
preferences.title: Upcoming Runs to Show
preferences.description: How many upcoming run times to list when the command opens.

commands.name: unix-timestamp
commands.title: Unix Timestamp
commands.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, or nanoseconds) to a human-readable date and back

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time Format
preferences.description: Whether local and UTC times are shown in 24-hour or 12-hour notation.

commands.name: unicode-browser
commands.title: Unicode Browser
commands.description: Browse and search Unicode characters and blocks — grid view, per-character details, and copy as character, code point, HTML entity, or JS escape

commands.name: text-encoder
commands.title: Text Encoder/Decoder
commands.description: Encode and decode text live between Base 64, Base 64 URL, Base 32, Hex, URL, and Binary, with a selectable text encoding

commands.name: base64-encode
commands.title: Base64 Encode
commands.description: Encode the clipboard text as Base 64

commands.name: base64-decode
commands.title: Base64 Decode
commands.description: Decode the clipboard's Base 64 to text

commands.name: url-encode
commands.title: URL Encode
commands.description: Percent-encode the clipboard text

commands.name: url-decode
commands.title: URL Decode
commands.description: Decode the clipboard's percent-encoding to text

commands.name: lowercase
commands.title: Lowercase
commands.description: Convert the clipboard text to lowercase

commands.name: uppercase
commands.title: Uppercase
commands.description: Convert the clipboard text to uppercase

commands.name: jwt
commands.title: JWT Inspector
commands.description: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens — copy individual claims, with a syntax-highlighted header and payload

commands.name: decimal-to-hex
commands.title: Decimal to Hexadecimal
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's decimal number to hexadecimal

commands.name: hex-to-decimal
commands.title: Hexadecimal to Decimal
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's hexadecimal number to decimal

commands.name: decimal-to-binary
commands.title: Decimal to Binary
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's decimal number to binary

commands.name: binary-to-decimal
commands.title: Binary to Decimal
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's binary number to decimal

commands.name: json-converter
commands.title: JSON Converter
commands.description: Convert between JSON, JSON5, YAML, TOML, JS/TS objects, XML, CSV/TSV, .env and query strings; evaluate a JS snippet into data, format, or minify

commands.name: format-json
commands.title: Format JSON
commands.description: Pretty-print the clipboard's JSON

commands.name: minify-json
commands.title: Minify JSON
commands.description: Compress the clipboard's JSON to a single line

commands.name: json-to-yaml
commands.title: JSON to YAML
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's JSON to YAML

commands.name: yaml-to-json
commands.title: YAML to JSON
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's YAML to JSON

commands.name: json-to-js
commands.title: JSON to JS Object
commands.description: Convert the clipboard's JSON to a JavaScript object literal

commands.name: format-javascript
commands.title: Format JavaScript
commands.description: Pretty-print JavaScript with configurable indentation, quotes, semicolons, and trailing commas

commands.name: format-typescript
commands.title: Format TypeScript
commands.description: Pretty-print TypeScript with configurable indentation, quotes, semicolons, and trailing commas

commands.name: format-css
commands.title: Format CSS
commands.description: Pretty-print CSS with configurable indentation and print width

commands.name: format-scss
commands.title: Format SCSS
commands.description: Pretty-print SCSS with configurable indentation and print width

commands.name: format-less
commands.title: Format Less
commands.description: Pretty-print Less with configurable indentation and print width

commands.name: format-html
commands.title: Format HTML
commands.description: Pretty-print HTML with configurable indentation and print width

commands.name: format-xml
commands.title: Format XML
commands.description: Pretty-print XML with configurable indentation and print width

commands.name: format-sql
commands.title: Format SQL
commands.description: Pretty-print SQL with a selectable dialect and keyword case

commands.name: format-markdown
commands.title: Format Markdown
commands.description: Pretty-print Markdown with a configurable print width and prose wrap

commands.name: format-yaml
commands.title: Format YAML
commands.description: Pretty-print YAML with configurable indentation

commands.name: minify-javascript
commands.title: Minify JavaScript
commands.description: Minify JavaScript with mangling, compression, and console/comment removal

commands.name: minify-typescript
commands.title: Minify TypeScript
commands.description: Strip types and minify TypeScript with mangling, compression, and console/comment removal

commands.name: minify-css
commands.title: Minify CSS
commands.description: Minify CSS with structural optimization and comment removal

commands.name: minify-html
commands.title: Minify HTML
commands.description: Minify HTML, collapsing whitespace and minifying inline JS and CSS

commands.name: minify-xml
commands.title: Minify XML
commands.description: Minify XML by collapsing inter-tag whitespace and stripping comments

commands.name: minify-sql
commands.title: Minify SQL
commands.description: Minify SQL by collapsing whitespace and stripping comments

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
